title: Check and fix the example with the default theme
body:
Not sure if we have any dataset left, either we update one of the examples to use the new default widgets design or we create a new example.

We could also use the npm dataset: http://npmjs-instant-search-demo.heroku.com/

And also fix a few bugs:

* \[ ] hierarchical menu: based on float left, it breaks the margin top of the elements below
* \[ ] searchbox: no background
* \[ ] numeric range: inputs are too big
